title: Core: AS2 logical operators (&&, ||, !)
description: Test compilation of: a && b (short-circuit AND), a || b (short-circuit OR), !a (ActionNot 0x14), a && b && c (chained), a || b || c (chained), !(a && b), a ? b : c (ternary — already tested). Verify ActionAnd (0x10) or short-circuit jump approach via ActionIf (0x9D). Test in if conditions and assignment expressions.
